{{short description|Italian applied mathematician}}
{{use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=April 2020}}
'''Antonella Munthe-Kaas Zanna''' is an Italian applied mathematician and [[numerical analysis|numerical analyst]] whose research includes work on [[numerical integration]] of [[differential equation]]s and applications to [[medical imaging]]. She is a professor and head of the mathematics department at the [[University of Bergen]] in Norway.{{r|uib}}

==Education==
Zanna was born in [[Molfetta]], in southern Italy, and earned a degree in mathematics from the [[University of Bari]].
She completed her PhD in the [[Faculty of Mathematics, University of Cambridge#Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics|Department of Applied Mathematics and Theoretical Physics]] at the [[University of Cambridge]]{{r|oldhome}} in 1998. Her dissertation, ''Numerical Solution of Isospectral Flows'', was supervised by [[Arieh Iserles]].{{r|mg}}

==Recognition==
Zanna won the Second Prize in the [[Leslie Fox Prize for Numerical Analysis]] in 1997.{{r|fox}}
She is a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]].{{r|ntva}}

==Personal life==
Zanna married to Norwegian mathematician [[Hans Munthe-Kaas]] in 1997; they have four children.{{r|hub}}
